meta.title: Legal Notices & Disclaimers
meta.description: Legal notices and disclaimers for the KUL Enterprises LLC website.

sections.heading: Pictures & wordmark
sections.body: Every photograph on this website was taken by our founder while driving in the United States. There is no licensed or stock photography on the site. The opening film and the equipment drawings are computer generated and depict the tractor and trailer this company operates. Equipment shown may differ in specification, configuration or livery from the equipment assigned to any particular load. All third-party word marks and logos that may appear remain the property of their respective owners, and any use of such marks is under license or by permission.

sections.heading: Service information
sections.body: Service descriptions, coverage areas, capacity, and transit expectations presented on this website are obtained under normal operating conditions and may vary depending on the lane, season, weather, road and environmental conditions, and applicable hours-of-service regulations. Nothing on this website constitutes a rate quotation or a commitment of capacity. Freight moves under signed agreements, including rate confirmations and broker-carrier agreements, and those documents govern in the event of any difference.

sections.heading: Copyright & IP
sections.body: This website and its contents are protected by various intellectual property rights, including without limitation copyright, design rights, and trademarks, that are owned or licensed by {legalName}. You may not copy or use this website or any of its contents for any commercial purpose without our prior written consent. The KUL Enterprises name, the lion mark, and the Doctor Bird device are marks of {legalName}.

sections.heading: Brokers & partners
sections.body: Freight brokers, agents, and partner carriers are not agents of {legalName} and have no authority to bind {legalName} by any express or implied undertaking or representation. Arrangements made through brokers or agents are subject to their own terms and conditions.

sections.heading: Operating authority & verification
sections.body: {legalName} operates as a for-hire interstate motor carrier under USDOT {usdot}, based in {location}. Authority and safety records are public and can be verified through the FMCSA SAFER system. Auto liability and cargo coverage are maintained as required by federal regulation, and certificates of insurance are issued directly by our insurer on request.
